description: List the Discord guilds (servers) the authenticated bot account belongs to. Use this to discover available guild IDs before calling guild-scoped tools, or to check membership counts. Page older results with before and newer results with after. Under DISCORD_MCP_ALLOWED_GUILDS, paging parameters must be omitted; every allowed guild is returned in a single call. Returns partial guild objects plus next_before and next_after cursors; both are set only when the page is full, so a full page can be followed by an empty one, and both are null when the page holds fewer guilds than limit. No special bot permissions. Read-only; safe to retry.

after.description: Guild ID cursor to page forward; returns guilds with IDs larger than this snowflake. Omit when DISCORD_MCP_ALLOWED_GUILDS is set

before.description: Guild ID cursor to page backwards; returns guilds with IDs smaller than this snowflake. Omit when DISCORD_MCP_ALLOWED_GUILDS is set

limit.description: Maximum number of guilds to return (1 to 200, default 200). Omit when DISCORD_MCP_ALLOWED_GUILDS is set

with_counts.description: Whether to include approximate_member_count and approximate_presence_count in response objects; defaults to false

name: discord_list_my_guilds

id.description: Discord snowflake ID as a numeric string
